segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: It is my privilege to present to this August Chamber the proposed 2027 budget of the Department of Finance and its attached agencies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Here with us, Mr. Speaker, is the Secretary, the Undersecretary, and all the heads of the attached agencies of the Department of Finance,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: headed, of course, by Secretary Frederick Go.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Your Honors, the Department of Finance stands as the central engine of our country's economic progress.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: beyond the mere collection agency, it is tasked with the profound responsibility to architect our nation's fiscal policies,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: empower our local governments toward fiscal independence, and navigate our public sector debt.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: As emphasized in the President's Budget Message for Fiscal Year 2027,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: the government's fiscal strategy remains anchored on strengthening revenue generation

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: while ensuring that public expenditures continue to support inclusive and sustainable economic growth.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Again, I've mentioned earlier, 56.8% lang po yung ating debt to GDP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: And based on the prudent fiscal management that we have, as we have already until today itemized,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: It would even go lower, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: It would even go lower in the coming years, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: We anticipate that in the next year, it will be down to 56.1%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So, basically, if we do reference, use the reference of the International Monetary Rate as our basis

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: to either say that we are now in deep trouble or we are okay or healthy in our financial standing,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: I think the number would not lie.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: 56.8% is way, way below the 70% benchmark on the International Monetary Rate na sinasabi po nilang medyo may problema doon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So, medyo mababa po yung ating rate doon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So, ibig sabihin po, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor, wala po dapat ipangamba ang taong bayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: We can confidently say that dapat huwag tayo mangamba dahil unang-una.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Again, let me reiterate because we're talking about borrowing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: We're also talking about our gross borrowing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Sinasabi po natin na hindi po tayo mapagamba kasi very less po yung possibility that we will also be affected

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: by international shocks or the fluctuating monetary rates kasi ang borrowing pala talaga natin are mostly our gross domestic borrowing,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: At sinasabi po natin, ang ating nagiging baseline is yung 70% po na threshold na binigay po ng World Bank na sinabi po ng World Bank

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: na para ma-determine whether the sustainable yung debt levels ng ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Again, I've already given, Mr. Speaker, your honors, the numbers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: That is why with 58.6%, no, ang ating, ang ating, ang ating, ano, debt, no,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: debt to GDP, Mrs. Speaker, ay medyo mababa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Iyon po yung rason, Mrs. Speaker, na marami pong pumapasok sa atin ng mga investors.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: We have, because we have a very good investment ratings, no.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: In fact, the best rating agencies also come out with that study na among many countries, as I've cited to you,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: just to specifically give you an example, sa ASEAN, we are the lowest, no, ng rate na sinabi po ng,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: At the same time, mataas po ang ating credit rating.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: That's why many investors do have confidence to put up their money in this country, Mrs. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So, yes, to give you a short answer, we are confident and we are, we can manage over the years.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, distinguished sponsor, sa inyong kasagutan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Sa punto po kasing ito, nilalatag natin ang lahat ng mga numero, pero ang akin lang pong isang, maibahagi ko lang po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: sa, hindi po ako ekonomista, gusto ko pong unawain ang kalagayan ng ating bansa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: isa lang po ang naiintindihan ko sa puntong ito bilang mambabatas at sa experience ko bilang mambabatas,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: itong mga numero ito, hindi maintindihan kung ang ating, sa pagganap ng ating batas,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: tuwing-tugi tayo magpapasa ng batas, magiging unfunded mandate, kasi walang pera.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Kaya tuwing budget hearing, magre-request po tayo na taasan ng mga pondo para sa mga programa at proyektong tingin natin ay dapat naman talaga mabigyan ng mataas na pagpupondo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Katulad po sa human capital development, paano po natin maiintindihan yung mga figures na yan na sinasabing manageable yan, sustainable, kaya hindi po masama ang mangutang, lalo na po kung inuutang natin will redound to the greater benefit of our people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Pero ang nakakabahala lang po kasi tuwing-tuwing magbabudget hearing tayo, ang atin pong naririnig lagi, tight fiscal space.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Hindi ko po alam kung default answer yan or excuse, pero tuwing-tuwi, tight fiscal space.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Ang tanong ko po, huling katanungan ko na lamang po, paano pa ho ba natin luluwagan ang fiscal space na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Your Honors, marami pong posibleng kasagutan dyan, pero as far as the Department of Finance is concerned,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: and its main task really is to source out,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: revenue in order that we can finance capital investments, kung ano po yung mga gastusin ng ating bansa, of course, hindi po tayo matatapos sa 30 minutes kung tayo po iisa-isahin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Pero kaya nga po, meron po tayong prudent fiscal management para nata-target po natin kung ano yung paggagastusan ng ating bawat ehansya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Ay yun po ay binabangga po natin kung ano pong meron tayo as a relative, just to give you a straight answer, pareho tayo, hindi po rin ako ekonomista,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: pero ang tinitingnan ko po ay paano yung nagiging...

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: nagiging returns itong mga services na ito sa ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So definitely, there are, should be, number one, a prudent fiscal planning.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: The fiscal management will only expand if there are revenues that we collect,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: not only from the tax revenue collection, but even the non-tax proceeds, the revenues.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So it's how we can actually generate local economy, generate more jobs,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: and as well as to, you know, to get more revenue in order that we can actually expand the fiscal space.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Kasi mag-expand lang po yan kung gaano rin po kalaki yung ating pera.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Kaya babalikan ko po kasi I think the question...

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Kaya nga po, ang pangungutang hindi naman po talaga siya masama.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Kaya nga, dapat meron coupled with prudent fiscal planning

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: kasi yung pangungutang, mas maganda po yan

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: kung nagtitrigger po yan ng economic activity sa baba.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: And you agree on me on this, Mr. Speaker, Your Honors.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Kaya nga po, talagang ginagawa po natin

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: na mapababa din po yung ating debt to GDP,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: deficit to GDP, kasi sa standing po talaga natin

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: is sustainable pa po yung ating debt levels

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: at saka doon po yung rason kung bakit marami pong pumapasok

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: sa atin ng mga investors at dinadala po nila

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: ang kanilang mga kapital dito sa ating bansa

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: na nakakapagdagdag din po to revenue

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: or possible na pinagkukuhanan po natin

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: ng paggagastusan para po mapalawak po natin

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: at mapalaki po natin ang ating fiscal space.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So just to give you that answer,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: comes different on different levels and different variables.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Pero sa ngayon po, based on the data, sinasabi po natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: we anticipate also the growth as far as how the trajectory

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: of the data of the Department of Finance is concerned

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: and we hope that it can continue on

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: because our number one priority is not just to lower down our debt to GDP

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: but also to create more or to spur the local economy in our country

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: so that it can also be translated into more revenue

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: hayaan nyo na lamang po akong ipahayag

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: na ako'y kaisa ninyo na umaasa

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: na makakamit natin ang lahat na assumptions

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: para po pagbalik ninyo sa bulwagang ito

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: sa susunod na taon, sa susunod na budget hearing

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: ay masasabi nyo na po sa amin

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor, and to the DOF.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, idadagdag ko lang po

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: para po mapanatag po ang kalooban ng ating mga kasamahan dito

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: lalong-lalong na po ang good interpellator.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: In fact, Mr. Speaker, one indication na okay lang po po yung kating katayuan

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: dahil we are actually spending more than compared to our ASEAN neighbors, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: In fact, may 22% po of our GDP is what we used for expenditure.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: We spent so much, Mr. Speaker, and so more.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: ating pumapasok po sa atin na ating nagagastos. [unclear] Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Thank you po, Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yasser Alonto Balindong
segments.text: Thank you very much, Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Patricia C. Calderon
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, next to interpellate the sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Patricia C. Calderon
segments.text: I move to recognize Representative JCM Abalos

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yasser Alonto Balindong
segments.text: The Honorable JC Abalos is recognized.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Speaker, sa DOF,

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: pati sa kanyang mga naka-akibat na ahensya, magandang magandang tanghali po.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, is the Distinguished Sponsor willing to yield to this representation

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: for a very few amount of questions?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Nobody says no to Abalos from Mandaluyong, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: Sa pagkakataong ito, Mr. Speaker, may mga katanungan lamang po ako

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: tungkol sa RPVARA o ang tinatawag nating Real Property Assessment and Valuation and Assessment Reform Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: otherwise known as the Real Property Valuation and Assessment Reform Act,

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: was enacted to modernize and standardize the country's real property valuation and assessment system,

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: and strengthen fiscal capacity of local government units.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, while the objectives of the law remain worthy and necessary,

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: This representation believes that we have the continuing duty to ensure that the implementation remains responsive to prevailing economic realities and does not result in unintended burdens upon the Filipino people.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, mula noong naisabatas natin ang RPVARA, mula noon hanggang ngayon, nagbago na po ang economic realities na hinaharap ng ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: Noong ito ay naipasa, hindi pa po nangyari ang Middle East oil crisis at hindi pa po ganun kasama ang inflation.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: If I may add po, Mr. Speaker, nag-file po tayo ng House Resolution noong nakaraang July kung saan nananawagan po tayo na panahon na po siguro na reviewhin natin ang RPVARA at aralin po natin kung napapanahon po ba ito or kung kakailanganin siyang suspindihin.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: And, Mr. Speaker, if I may add...

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: Last August, no less than our President, President Bongbong Marcos, sought for temporary suspension of real property valuation implementation to protect businesses and investments.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: If I may quote, Mr. Speaker, ang ating Palace Press Officer, sinabi po ng ating Pangulo noong nakaraang Augusto, nagpanukala si Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr. sa dalawang kapulungan ng LEDAC meeting noong August 6, 2026,

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: pagpapatupad ng Real Property Valuation and Assessment Reform Act or RPVARA upang maiwasan ang karagdagang mga gastos sa ari-arian para sa mga negosyo,

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: suportahan ang mga pamumuhunan at tiyakin ang isang dahan-dahan at makatwirang transisyon patungo sa bagong valuation system.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: At ito rin po ang naging rekomendasyon ng Private Sector Advisory Council.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: That being said, Mr. Speaker, gusto ko po malaman...

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: sa DOF, kung ano po ang kanilang posisyon pagdating po sa pagsuspende ng RPVARA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, ang Department of Finance naman po ay nag-complying with whatever policies and enactment of any laws in relation to any of the taxes, the form of taxes that the Congress would impose or would enact.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So, isa po rito yung RPVARA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So, ang posisyon po ng Department of Finance dyan ay willing po sila. May defer implementation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: In fact, kung yun po ang ninanais ng legislatura, halimbawa, to extend the suspension or defer the implementation of RPVARA,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: then Department of Finance more than willing to implement the extension, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, before I wind up my interpellation for the DOF, para lang po sa appreciation ng ating mga kababayan na nakikinig ngayon,

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: dahil marami pong panawagan na suspendehin yung RPVARA mula po sa mga assessor, mula sa mga stakeholder, at mula rin po sa ating Pangulo.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: Meron po bang datos ang DOF kung ano ang maaaring economic impact kung sakaling itutuloy po natin ang RPVARA as scheduled?

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: Dahil sa aking pag-unawa, Mr. Speaker, kung magkakaroon po tayo ng bagong schedule of market values, maraming buwis po ang pwedeng maapektuhan.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: Magpabigat sa ating mga kababayan. Isa na po dito ang binabayad nating amilyar, capital gains tax, documentary stamp tax siguro, donor's tax.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: May epekto rin po ba ito sa cost of housing? Paano po nito aapektuhan ang mga negosyo, ang mga upa, ang presyo ng upa?

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: So maaari po ba, Mr. Speaker, ipaliwanag sa atin ng DOF kung ano po ang posibleng economic impact ng RPVARA if we continue?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Yeah, Mr. Speaker, Your Honors. Well, wala hong, there's no, there's no actual and definite data that we can provide, the good gentleman, from Congressman Abalos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: But certainly, Mr. Speaker, kasi ang formulation po nito ng RPVARA is this is a local government revenue, hindi naman po siya national taxes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Talking about local assessors, you understand also the impact of this on our people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Kasi every local assessors would also, the valuation board would also depend on the income classification of each city and municipality.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Kaya nga po ang ating Department of Finance is supporting whatever would be to defer implementation of RPVARA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So going back to your question, probably mayroon pong slowing down of economic activity.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: But as to, as concrete and tangible answer to that, based on concrete data that we have, wala po sa ngayon ang Department of Finance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Because again, these are normally resourced out or be collected from the local government revenue, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, for expediency, naniniwala po ako, Mr. Speaker, na hindi naman po basta-basta mananawagan ng ating,

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: Pangulo, na suspendihin yung RPVARA kung wala po tayong pinapagbasihan.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: So for expediency, Mr. Speaker, at dahil meron rin naman po ako nakahain na House Resolution na nananawagan na reviewhin natin yung RPVARA,

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: baka maaaring mag-furnish na lang po ang DOF sa representasyong ito, kung ano yung maaaring available data,

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: kung ano po ang inyong policy recommendations para at least ma-address po natin ang concerns ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: We can ensure and we can assure the good gentleman, good interpellator.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Magbibigay po kami mga kinakailangan niyo po o ninanais niyo po ang data galing po sa Department of Finance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: And advance congratulations po and good luck po sa inyong resolution na ipafile.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC M. Abalos
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Distinguished Sponsor, and sa DOF, no further questions po. Thank you po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Patricia C. Calderon
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, next to interpellate the sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Patricia C. Calderon
segments.text: I move to recognize Representative Edgar R. Erice of the 2nd District, Caloocan City.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yasser Alonto Balindong

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa ilalim ng Republic Act No. 12316, binigyan ang Pangulo ng Kapangyarihang magsuspinde o magbawas ng excise tax sa mga produktong petrolyo

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: kapag ang average ng Dubai crude oil price ay umabot o lumagpas na sa 80.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: USD kada barile sa loob ng isang buwan. Ang rekomendasyon ay manggagaling mula sa DBCC in coordination sa DOE.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nagbigay na rin ang DOE ng certification na umabot, lumagpas na dito sa trigger na 80 USD na threshold sa presyo ngayon na umabot na sa 99.41 USD ang Dubai crude oil price.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang DOF ay bahagi ng DBCC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At nabalitaan po natin na mayroong bagong anunsyo ng suspensyon ng excise tax lamang sa LPG at kerosene ang rekomendasyon ng DBCC. Hanggang kailan po ang suspensyon na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, maximum of tatlong buwan pero pwede po ito nari-renew. Depende din po ito sa kalagayan sa merkado ng petrolyo, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, nitong Abril din, nagkaroon ng parehong suspensyon sa LPG lamang at kerosene.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At sangayon sa batas, dapat within 15 days, nung mula doon sa suspensyon na iyon noong April, nakapagbigay ng ulat ang DBCC sa House of Representatives at sa Senado ng report tungkol sa una,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: yung factual basis at policy goals.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Para doon sa suspensyon at reduction ng excise tax.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pangalawa, ano ba yung buong bilang ng estimated foregone revenues, kasama na yung affected social benefits para sa iba't ibang household deciles.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kabilang din, ginoong speakers sa dapat nilang maisumite, ano ba yung expected impact sa inflation at fuel prices, cost-benefit analysis,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: assessment ng possible market distortions, leakages,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: unintended consequences na magmumula doon sa suspensyon at reduction ng excise taxes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang ulat ba na ito ay nasumitin na sa House of Representatives at sa Senado?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Yes, meron na pong report na sinumiti ang Department of Finance patungkol po doon sa lahat na concerns na nilatag po ng ating kagalang-galang na interpellator.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maari ba tayong makakuha ng kopya ngayon, ginoong speaker?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Yes, we will furnish po, Mr. Speaker, the study, the assessment report, Mr. Speaker, that we have, that the Department of Finance has gathered.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Pero ito po, again, ito pong reaction ng ating bansa dito sa hostility na gaganap po sa gitnang silangan na naapektuhan po yung krudo, yung presyo ng krudo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Hindi lang po ang Department of Finance ang nag-a-assess po nito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, in fact, meron po tayong executive order po na diniklara ng ating presidente.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Kung yun po yung katanungan ng ating kagalang-galang na interpreter tungkol po sa energy crisis na na-experience po natin sa ngayon, Mr. Speaker, your honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, magkano ba yung tinataya natin na pagbaba ng presyo ng LPG at kerosene sa ngayon?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Itong nakaraang araw sa excise taxes sa LPG at kerosene.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Magkano yung tinatayang pagbaba ng presyo?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Wait lang po, Mr. Speaker, your honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Pag-re-refer po tayo sa data, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mahalaga ito, ginoong speaker, kasi sa bawat aksyon, yung inaasahan naman ng ating mga kababayan, yung madama at malaman nil agad yung pagbaba ng presyo ng LPG at kerosene.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kung ano ba yung pagtugon nito doon sa tunay ng mga panawagan at pangangailangan ngayon ng ating mga kababayan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, doon po sa, dalawa po kasi yan, Mr. Speaker, di ba, sa suspensyon ng excise tax.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Meron pong 5 pesos per liter sa kerosene.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: And then 37 per cylinder para po sa ating liquefied petroleum gas or LPG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon naman, ginawang speaker, kung gagamitin din natin ang parehong kapangyarihan ng pagsususpinde o pagbabawas ng excise tax, sa diesel naman at sa gasoline,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: magkano kaya yung tinataya na maaaring pagbaba ng presyo kada litro?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: 6 pesos po para po sa diesel per liter, 10 pesos po per liter sa gasolina.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon, ginawang speaker, bakit po ba hindi nakonsidera yung pagsasama ng diesel at gasoline sa sinuspinde at binabaan sa excise tax bilang pagtugon natin sa matinding krisis na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ginawang speaker na lubos na apektado nitong nakaraang buwan sa pagtaas ng presyo ng langis ay nakabangon, lalong-lalo na sa sektor ng transportasyon, sa agrikultura, sa mga magsasaka na ginagamit ang diesel at gasolina para sa kanilang makinarya at traktor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: sa mga manginisda na nakadepende ang kanilang paglalaot sa presyo din ng krudo, hindi pa yan lahat na bibigyan ng tulong, hindi pa po yan lahat ay naabot ng ayuda.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kulang na kulang din yung mga fuel subsidies para maabot ang lahat ng ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Hindi pa sila nakakabangon at hindi pa po makatugon sa tindi ng krisis ngayon, lalo na ngayong buwan, ginawang speaker, ginawang sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayong Setiembre pa lang, pumarap tayo sa tatlong magkakasunod na malalaking oil price hike.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At sa katunayan, sa diesel, umabot na po ng nasa 104 pesos kada litro, sa gasolina naman umabot na ng nasa 87 pesos kada litro.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Hindi biro ang pagtataas na ito ng presyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya, bakit ba muli na hindi na naman po sinama yung konsiderasyon ng diesel at gasolina sa pagsususpinde at pagpapababa ng excise taxes sa mga nasabing petroleum products?

segments.text: Mrs. Speaker, ang targeted po, ang response po ng energy crisis sa ngayon, dapat din po targeted.

segments.text: So, may tulong po sa ating mga transportation sector.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So, ibig sabihin, dapat po, meron din po tayong pagpunan na revenue,

segments.text: na para po masustentuhan itong pangangailangan na assistance sa mga sektor na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So, transportation sector ang naapektuan po dito.

segments.text: Even, na-mention nga din po ng ating kagalanggalang na interpolator.

segments.text: So, naiintindihan po natin ang concern ng ating kagalanggalang na interpolator.

segments.text: na ang magiging problema kung ito pong gagawin natin ay wala na po tayong possible na mapagkunan

segments.text: dahil meron namang ayuda, meron namang mga subsidiya.

segments.text: Ngunit, malimbawa na lang po at nais ko po,

segments.text: ma-present po niyo sana yung buong mga figures para makita natin yung buong larawan ng sitwasyon.

segments.text: Pero sa bahagi pa lang po ng mga manging isda,

segments.text: no, ilan lang po yung nabigyan ng ayuda na nasa 2,000 pesos.

segments.text: At sa katunayan, hindi pa po lahat ng mga lugar na nangangailangan ay naaabot niyan.

segments.text: Sa tingin niyo po ba makatarungan na ganito yung nangyayari?

segments.text: So sa ngayon po, dahil nga from March to June...

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Itong taon na po ito, meron pong collection from, meron pong additional VAT collection na 21 billion pesos starting March to June sa fuel po ito, diesel at saka gasoline.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: At meron po tayong, from total po, from starting March up to September 7, 2026, meron pong 32.6 VAT collection po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Projected po. Itong 32.6 na billion pesos na additional VAT collection po dito po sa mga pangunahing commodities na na-mention po ng ating kagalang-galang na interpeler ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Kinoong Speaker. Hindi po ba kumita pa po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang pamahalaan mula doon sa mas mataas na VAT collection?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Well, yun nga po, at the face value, at the face value, at the face value, tama po pero gumagastos din po kasi kailangan po natin magkaroon kung saan yung pan, saan po natin kukunin itong mga subsidiya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So dahil tumataas po talaga yung presyo, dapat po, mas maganda rin po na meron tong pagkukunan ng ating pagbibigay na subsidiya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Ito pong 30, ito pong projected na 33.6 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Automatic po ito, yung paggagastusan po ng mga departamento doon po sa subsidiya binibigay po sa sektor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Hindi lang po, again, hindi lang po transportation sector, pati na rin po ang mga fisher folks, pati na rin po sa agrikultura, ang ating mga farmers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So talagang naka-identified po dapat yung paglalaanan itong nakukuhan po natin karagdagang VAT collection mula po sa mga petrolyong produkto na na-mention po ng ating kagalang-galang na interpeler.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang suliran rin kasi dito, Mr. Speaker, buti sana kung lahat po ng apektado ay nabibigyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Buong nawawala nilang kita sa isang araw ay napupunan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang problema po natin, hindi naman po ganun yung sitwasyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Halimbawa, sa mga nabisita po natin na mga manging isda, magpasa hanggang ngayon po, wala pang natatanggap na fuel subsidy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At yung DA naman po, nung nagsabi sila sa atin, at hindi nga lang pasensya, pero talagang natulak na natin sila dito sa Kongreso na dapat hindi magpatumpik-tumpik.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kasi bawat araw na nawawala, nawawala ng kita, nababawasan ng kita yung ating mga magsasakat, mga manging isda.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yan po ay katumbas ng pagkain nila sa pagkainan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Hindi po pareho yung epekto sa kanila sa epekto sa middle

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: class at sa mas may marangya at mas pasaganang buhay dito sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa katunayan po, sa mga manging isda, sila ay kumukonsumo ng 10 litro ng diesel kada fishing trip.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang balita nga po sa atin, maraming nakikiangkas o yung nakikisakay na lang sa bangka ng iba para lang po mas mapalaki nila yung kita.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dati, sila daw po ay kumikita ng nasa 800 to 1,000 pesos per day.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pero nung naglagpas na po sa 100 pesos ang presyo ng crudo, nasa 200 to 300 pesos na lang po yung kanilang kinikita.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: So ganito po katindi yung impact dun sa ating mga pinakamaliliit na sektor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ganon din po sa mga magsasaka.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Marami pong nag-iisip na magparenta ng lupa sa mga proyektong halimbawa ng solar na hindi na po talaga gustong magtanim.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dahil nga napakataas ng cost of production.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa panahon na hindi lang po langis yung apektado, pati fertilizer ay nakaka-apekto sa ating sektor ng agrikultura.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa mga jeepney drivers na kasalukuyan pong nagsasagawa ng transport strike, marami po sa kanila mas pipiliin na lang na hindi bumiyahe.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dahil kapag sila po ay bumiyahe, ay lugi pa sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: O kaya naman may nakakausap din po tayong mga TNVS drivers na nagsasabi na yung dating 12 hours po nila,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: kailangan nilang bumiyahe ng 14 to 15 hours.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: As in, wala na po talagang pahinga para lang meron lang kitain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Oo, marami po tayong natutulungan sa pamagitan ng mga fuel subsidies, mga targeted assistance sa mga sektor na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pero kailangan po natin ang mas malawakan na epekto na ang magsasakripisyo, yung pamahalaan naman,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: hindi yung tao na sobra-sobra ng pagtitiis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na presyo ng diesel, ng gasolina.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa katunayan nga, Mr. Speaker, nung dinedeliberate po natin yung ating panukala tungkol sa pagsususpende

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at pagbabawas ng excise taxes sa petroleum products sa pamagitan ng pag-provide ng emergency power sa Pangulo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: And I quote from their presentation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: The expected revenue losses from excise tax suspension can also be partially offset by the additional collection from VAT on oil.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: So, naka-offset naman po eh, yung maaring mabawas na revenues ng gobyerno mula sa excise taxes ng oil, ng petroleum products.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pero bakit hindi pa po natin itodo?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: LPG at kerosene ngayon, pero dapat po sana isama na natin yung pagsususpende rin ng excise taxes sa diesel at gasolina

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: para mas marami na makinabang, mas marami po tayong matulungan sa panahon ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yan po, noong matagal ng panawagan ng representasyon na ito at sana kumilos din ang Kongreso,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: kinakailangan na natin ng mas mabilis at mas decisive na aksyon para makatulong sa ating mga kababayan ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Your Honor, kami po ay nakikiisa sa panawagan ng ating butihing presentante ng Gabriela Partylist.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: In fact, naiintindihan po natin na hindi po naging madali ang naging kalagayan ng ating mga kababayan

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: simula po nagkaroon ng sigalot sa gitnang silangan na nakapekto po ito sa produkto ng petrolyo sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Kaya nga po sinasabi po ng Department of Finance, ang pangunahing mandato po ay maghanap po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: tayo ng gastusin para po mapunduhan natin at mabigyan natin ng karapatang sustento, support, ayuda, subsidies,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: ang mga naapektuhan po nitong energy crisis na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Kaya nga po dapat para sa amin, para sa Department of Finance,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: ay ang datos po kung saan nanggagaling yung servisyo, kung ano yung dapat nabigyan na beneficiaries

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Kung saan sila po yung may pangunahing mandatong magbigay nitong assistance na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Baga, simpleng explanation lang po, ang Department of Finance,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: maghahanap po yan ng karagdagang kita ng gobyerno para maibigay sa mga departamento nito

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: at yung mga departamento po ang magbibigay sa mga naapektuhan po ng crisis na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Pagdating naman po doon sa panahon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: panawagan na dapat pa ay may suspend din yung sa diesel, excise tax, at saka sa petroleum.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Ito po, again, ito pong Department of Finance, ang kanilang pong mandato ay tingnan

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: kung paano din po balansihin kasi mahirap naman po tayo ay magbigay ng supporta

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: na wala naman po tayong paghuhugutan saan kukunin yung supporta na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: In very ordinary situation, paano ka naman magbibigay ng isang,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: ng allowance sa imong anak kung wala ka naman talagang pwedeng pagpunahanan ng pera, diba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Ganon din po sa Department of Finance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Kung completely po na tayo po ay magsususpindi ng mga possible VAT collection po natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: ay maapektuhan din po yung ibibigay natin ng mga subsidies sa ating naapektuhan na sektor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So, kailangan din po natin balansihin yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Opo, kailangan din po natin balansihin yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Dahil sa katotohanang, dahil kailangan kulang, ay kailangan meron,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: hindi dapat na kulang, dapat meron po tayong pagbibigyan ng subsidya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Kung yun po ang gusto natin, again, sinabi na po ng ating butihing interpelator,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: ay mukhang question na po yan ng Congressional Act,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: kasi na-mention din po ng ating kagalang-galang,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Ang sinasabi lang po ng Department of Finance ay may possible na 10.6 billion pesos na losses na naman po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Tapos, ang translation naman po ito, ay maapektuhan din po yung revenue o pera

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: na pwede natin magamitin ng mga departamento para sila po ay magbigay ayuda

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Or assistance, subsidies sa mga naapektuang sektor, tulad nalimbawa ng DOTR,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: tulad nalimbawa ng Department of Agriculture, tulad nalimbawa ng DSWD.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So, kami po ay nakikisimpat siya, naniniwala po sa panawagan ng ating kagalang-galang na interpelator.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So, kailangan lang po natin balancing approach.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: We have the revenue that we have collected, and this revenue that we have collected will be specifically designed,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: or will be specifically used to target beneficiaries.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Without the ample resources that we generate, there's no possible way that we can actually respond

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: to the emergency brought about by the crisis in the Middle East, Mrs. Speaker, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, our distinguished sponsor, nanggaling din dito ang Department of Agriculture.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At nagtanong tayo kung ano ba yung posisyon nila tungkol dito sa pagpapababa ng presyo ng langis,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na po sa crudo na ginagamit nga sa sektor ng agrikultura.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kung sila lang nga lang po ang magdidesisyon, ang posisyon nila hindi lang pagbabasura o pagbabawas,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: pansamantala na excise taxes sa petroleum products.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang panawagan nga nila, maski po yung VAT sa langis ay dapat masuspindi,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: kung hindi man talagang buong-buong tanggalin dahil sa impact nito sa sektor ng agrikultura.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, kasi sana po kung wala pang efforts, yung DOF magpunta po kaya kayo doon sa linya ng transport strike.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mismo kausapin niyo po yung mga jeepney drivers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: As in, ibang level po ng kahirapan yung kanilang hinaharap ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pagdating naman sa mga magsasakat-mangingisda, ganon din po lubog sa utang sa mga microlending.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At kung saan-saan pa po na mga pautang at di pa po makabangon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon, ang challenge diyan, ginaong Speaker, wala ding pondo sa 2027 NEP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yung mga mahalaga sana ng programa para tulungan makabangon ang mga sektor na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Halimbawa, yung fuel subsidy ng LTFRB, zero for 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yung Presidential Assistance for Farmers and Fisherfolk na asahan sana natin for production subsidy ng Farmers and Fisherfolk, zero.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: So, ano pong aasahan ng mga sektor na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kundi yung decisive action na lang sana nabawasan yung mga pinapasan nilang mga buwis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Tulad po ng VAT, ng excise taxes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Doon lamang sa ating mga basic necessities and prime commodities na sana nga kung sa price act, masama na ang diesel at gasoline.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya po muli, ang hamon ko po sa DOF.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kasi nagtanong po tayo sa DA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang stand nila, mabawasan ang presyo ng langis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang stand din po ng DOE kung magdidesisyon naman na magkaroon ng pagbabawas ng presyo ng langis sa pagsususpindi ng excise taxes, welcome din naman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pero yun nga, ang sinasabi nila, hindi lang naman sila ang nagdidesisyon sa lahat ng ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At malaki ang role ng ating economic managers at yung DOF pang specifically yung binabanggit nila na hinihintay nila na rekomendasyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pagdating sa mga hakbang na yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya po, yun ang hamon natin sa ating economic managers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kausapin po kaya natin ng diretso yung ating mga sektor na ito na naapekto.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang tanungin po natin, naabot ba kayo ng mga targeted subsidies na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nakaabot ba sa inyo yung fuel subsidies?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nakatulong ba para makatuloy kayo ng laot?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nakatulong ba para makapagtanim kayo muli?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang laki po ng hamon sa ating bayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Malaking magagawa ng pagsususpindi ng excise taxes sa lahat ng petroleum products.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pag-aaral ng Kongreso para mabasura, mabawasan man lang ang 12% VAT sa pagkain, sa kuryente, sa langis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At pagtitiyak na sa 2027 na general appropriations natin, maisasama yung production subsidies, fuel subsidies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yung mga bagay po na mag-aangat talaga ng sektor ng agrikultura, fisheries.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At hindi lang po tayo nakaasa sa household consumption dahil sa mga patong-patong na mga buwis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yan po ang panawagan ng mga kababaihan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sana naman po, hindi lang sana, pero dapat lang, umaksyon agad ngayon sa panahon ng krisis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maraming salamat, ginoong speaker. Maraming salamat, ginoong sponsor. Maraming salamat.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, allow me to respond to the comments.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Make it brief. Can you make it brief, the response?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: I will, I will, I will respond to the comments, Mr. Speaker. Yes.

segments.text: Unang-una po, ang pangunahing mandato po ng Department of Finance,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: sa totoo lang po, Mr. Speaker, Your Honor, ay maghanap po...

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: sa NEP, kaya ang Department of Finance

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: case of doing business na wala rin po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: In fact, ang Bureau of Customs,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: na up-to-date na scanning devices, wala

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: na rin po. So, ibig sabihin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: may mga pondo po talaga per department

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Pero it's not, Mr. Speaker, Your Honor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Para po mas klaro po yun. In fact, Mr. Speaker,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: ating gobyerno, hindi lang po sa

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: assistance, pati na rin po yung

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: ng bawat departamento. So, kami po

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Kung tatanungin po ang Department of

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: ginagawa ng ating Department of Finance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya, Mr. Speaker, ang hamon po

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: sa atin, taasan naman natin yung

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: pondo para sa lokal na agrikultura

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: capacity ng mga sektor na ito

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
