segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: lubhang katiting ang naipapaabot ng tulong ng gobyerno kapag sila ay nagkakasakit at nangangailangan ng pagkalinga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: napakabigat na kapabayaan ng Department of Finance at ng DBCC na hindi masiguro ang tamang paglaan ng sin-tax revenues para sa universal health care ayon sa itinakda ng batas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Dahil sa kapabayaang ito, ang ating mga cancer patients at dialysis patients at iba pang may sakit na nawawalan na nga ng lakas na magtrabaho ay napipilitan pang manglimos, mangutang, at lumapit sa kung sino-sinong opisyal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: para lang makumpleto ang pambayad sa hospital bills.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Buhay at kaligtasan ng mamamayan ang nakataya rito,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: kaya marapat lamang na itama ang pondong ito upang mabigyan ng buo

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: at naayon sa batas ang perang nakalaan para sa kalusugan ng bawat Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I will, in the proper time, propose budget amendments

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: so that the shortfall for the earmarks be fully recognized and provided in the national budget.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Thank you very much, Representative Ismula, Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. De Carlo L. Uy
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, next to interpolate the sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. De Carlo L. Uy
segments.text: I move to recognize Representative Robert Nazal of Partylist BH.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: The gentleman from BH Partylist, Ms. Congressman Robert Nazal, is recognized.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Sir, you have the floor and you may proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Good afternoon to our distinguished sponsor and good afternoon to the DOF.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, through you, may I ask our distinguished colleague to confirm with the Secretary of Finance,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: is DOF aware that Section 11 of Republic Act No. 7722,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: expressly provides that the Commission shall appoint a reputable government financial institution

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: as portfolio manager of the Fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: This is with regards to the HEDF.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Yet, Executive Order No. 338, Series of 1996, which directs the transfer of public money to the Treasury, has been cited as the basis for the present arrangement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: How does that arrangement comply with the laws requirement for a government financial institution to manage the HEDF portfolio?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, let us state for the record, an Executive Order cannot amend or supersede an Act of Congress.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: E.O. 338 cannot be invoked to disregard Section 11 of Republic Act 7722.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: If the required portfolio management arrangement has been displaced, that is non-compliance with the law.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: now that this requirement has been brought squarely to DOF's attention,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: what corrective action will it take together with CHED and DBM,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: and what date will compliance to the law be ensured?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, again, apologies if this is just brought out in the open.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: I think the Department of Finance was trying to look at it, this particular law,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: with specific provision cited by the Good.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: We have been raising this, Distinguished Sponsor, since 2025.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Ang CHED po, alam po nila yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, ang tanong ko po, sumulat po ba ang CHED sa DOF, sa DBM, with regards to this?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Allow me first to give time for the Department of Finance to turn over the documents, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: If I may be allowed, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, may we request for a few-minute suspension?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Yeah, just to give accurate answer to Congressman Nazal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, the discussion is here.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, apologies if it took a while to get the exact letter. We do confirm that there's a letter request from the Commission on Higher Education. This is in relation to the abolition of, yeah, the travel taxation. So they're requesting, in lieu of that, can they be allowed, or can the Department of Finance create a

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: trust fund for this specific collection from the travel tax to support CHED, Mr. Speaker, Your Honor. Tama ba? That's in lieu of the abolition of the travel tax, Mr. Speaker, because I believe the collectibles from the travel tax go directly to the CHED and to Department [unclear]. So, with the abolition of the travel tax,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: ang hinihingi po ng CHED according to this letter, kung puwede pong magkaroon ng support. And then, if it's possible, let me just read to you, Mr. Speaker, the language of the letter. So, amount equivalent to no less than 3% but not more than 5% of their unimpaired surplus during the immediately preceding year. So this is the preceding year before the abolition.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So they are also requesting supposedly the trust fund to be created, established by the Department of Finance to support the need of the CHED.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Yes, we presume that it is in compliance with that law. So they are asking, so the DOF is inclined to grant the current...

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Wala pa, no? Okay, so it's a fund from the GFI, but the... Ma'am, sorry.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, sorry ha, sorry. To answer your question, yes, there was a letter request, but I will just have to read

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: for clarity and for accuracy. Read the letter of CHED to the DOF. If, Mr. Speaker, if I may be allowed. Remittances from government financial institutions under Section 10, paragraph B of Republic Act [unclear]. Government financing institutions identified and requested by the Commission may contribute to the Fund an amount equivalent to not less than 3% but not more than 5% of

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: the unimpaired surplus realized during the immediately preceding year. Further, Section 73 of Republic Act No. 9593 provides that the national government shall look for alternative funding sources for programs funded by the travel tax in the event of a phase-out of travel tax collection following the international agreements. Opening and management of trust fund. They are requesting, in relation to the receipt of the aforementioned GFI contributions and other sources specified

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: under Section 10 of RA 7722, we seek guidance on establishment and operation of a dedicated trust fund account with the Bureau of Treasury.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, may I interrupt my distinguished colleague? So the letter, Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, is basically about asking for an alternative to the abolition of the travel tax. Is that correct?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: I'm sorry, Your Honor. Yes, we do confirm that there was a letter.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Yes. So what I'm asking basically is how do we intend to comply with the law considering po na meron pang pera under the HEDF? So the money should supposedly be in a GFI, in a government financial institution in compliance with the law. Meron pa ring pera from the travel tax na nakuha ang HEDF.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So ang tinatanong ko po, are we going to comply with that? Are we inclined to comply with that, na ilagay po yung pondo sa isang GFI?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Yes, okay, Mr. Speaker, we will comply with what the law says. Mr. Speaker, again, let me quote Section 11 just for accuracy of responding to your question. Management, Section 11, management and administration of the Higher Education Development Fund. The Fund shall be administered by the Commission,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: meaning the CHED, Mr. Speaker, Your Honor. For sound and judicious management of the Fund, the Commission shall appoint a reputable government financial institution as portfolio manager of the Fund, subject to the following conditions. And there are several conditions, Mr. Speaker. So, in a nutshell, Mr. Speaker, it is the CHED that actually should administer the funding, and they should also appoint and then decide who will be the manager.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So my basic question, distinguished sponsor, is when will this be complied with?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Meron na po bang concrete action on when this will happen?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Yeah, again, Mr. Speaker, it's based on the understanding of the DAF on the specific provision under the law.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: It should be the CHED, Mr. Speaker, that directly...

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: But the funds are currently with the BTR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: You're asking if there's some money, Mr. Speaker, Your Honor?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And I think the DOF should intervene and help the CHED para makapag-comply po with the law.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So, we will comply with whatever is the parameter set by the law as referenced by the good gentleman, Nadal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: The DOF will sit down with the CHED in order to facilitate in connection with the letter

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: and as well as the provisions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Under the specific law, Mr. Speaker, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Can we get a timeline and a commitment from DOF on when they intend to comply with this?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: We will just have to coordinate with the Commission on Higher Education.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: But definitely, once there will be a set-up schedule for specific coordination,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: I can assure you, I can guarantee to you, as a sponsor of their budget,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: I will ask the DOF to...

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, may I request for a written commitment?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: We will assure the good gentleman, Congressman Nadal, that he will be informed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Distinguished sponsor, Mr. Speaker, may I move to my next question?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: I would like to go to fuel marking.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, through you, may I ask our distinguished colleague,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: what independent evidence shows that fuel marking resists dilution, blending, and chemical alteration?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: How does the current program detect fuel entering outside the formal importation and marking process?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Well, our declared import volume increased by 77%,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: while duties and taxes collected rose by 179%, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So, the annual fuel import volumes, Mr. Speaker, increased by about 11.2 billion liters.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: The result of that is the additional 163.54 billion in our annual collection, Mr. Speaker, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Have we monitored? Do we have data on magkano po yung hindi natin nakita?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: How much was lost due to smuggling, despite the marking?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And the current program, are we evaluating the current program?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, just to respond to that, Congressman Nazal,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, what we can actually give you as a concrete data

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: is based on those commodities that have been nakuha or na-reprimand or na-secure

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: ng Bureau of Customs as a product of their anti-smuggling operation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: But as to the entirety of how much do we lose because of tax leakages through smuggling,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: we can only give you just an approximate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Pero what we can provide you is the actual seizures amount of commodities that the BOC has.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Ever since we implemented the Fuel Marking Program, since 2023 to 2024, Customs reported 142 apprehensions, 31 cases, but only from this Fuel Marking Program, only one conviction.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, may I ask what are the updated convictions and actual tax risk recoveries?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Are inspections reaching high-risk independent stations?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Does the current program provide for that?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: High-risk independent stations, depots, and vessels.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Where are the cases getting stuck?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And what will the DOF change in the current program?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, due to the adjustment from the DOJ's filing of the cases with a certainty of conviction, Mr. Speaker, the Department of, I'm sorry, the Bureau of Customs also has to review those cases,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: adjust these filings so that they can actually reach the quantum of evidence that the DOJ is now requiring, cases filed, which is basically a certainty of conviction once they file these cases, Mr. Speaker, Your Honor. But there have been cases that have already been filed by the Bureau of Customs, Mr. Speaker, before the Department of Justice, Mr. Speaker. But some that they need also to reevaluate so that they can

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: refile it again, this time with ample evidences to achieve that certainty of conviction, Mr. Speaker, as requested or as defined under the new ruling of the Department of Justice, Mr. Speaker, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, may I ask, through the distinguished sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: The number of seizures, Mr. Speaker, as...

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: As to the fuel or oil smuggling, the Bureau of Customs has already had 52 seizures amounting to an estimated value of 202...

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: 202 million 51,645 and 95 centavos, to be exact.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: In the interest of time, distinguished sponsor, may I just ask for the copy of the data?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Yes, yes, we will provide your copy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, distinguished sponsor, through you, Mr. Speaker, how much additional revenue is genuinely attributable to fuel marking after accounting for tax increases, oil prices, and import volumes?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Again, since we have already increased yung collection natin from 179,000 percent, so the exact amount is 163.54 billion pesos in our annual collection of gas markings, Mr....

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And this is attributable to fuel marking?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: May I ask for a full report on this?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Yes, we will definitely submit to you a hard copy in the study of that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Projection of that collection, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: We received reports po that the current arrangement has been cancelled.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Kasi parang ang understanding ko po, binibid out po yan eh, kung sino po yung proponent, ano.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And now, we are transferring to a PPP arrangement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, and they are proposing a 13.44 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: The current proposal proposes a 13.44 billion PPP arrangement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: May I ask, what is its cost per liter compared to the present contract?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And who will pay for this?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, as per offer, Mr. Speaker, it's 10 centavos per liter, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, yun po ang ipapatong for fuel marking?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: The oil companies, Mr. Speaker, yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, it will be charged to the consumers?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Who is currently paying for the current arrangement?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: The oil companies, Mr. Speaker, yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, based on the current arrangement, binibid out po yan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And how much is being charged currently?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Yes, because of the inflation, Mr. Speaker, that also is a considerable factor kung bakit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: 2018 kasi yung pricing, yung time na yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So, mayroon pong effect ng inflation, Mr. Speaker, yung honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Based on the current results, ever since we started implementing this,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: na isa lang po yung naging conviction,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: do you think, does the DOF think that this current system is effective?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Yeah, Mr. Speaker, again, yes, we understand, Mr. Speaker,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: but so far as the, you know, we're talking about smuggling here, right, Mr. Speaker, your honor?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Yes, yes, we understand that there is one conviction, Mr. Speaker,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: but then again, as to the exact, what is important, Mr. Speaker,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: if may hope that Congressman Nazal will also appreciate,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: value that we have seized, the Bureau of Customs has seized, which is, you know, I already gave you, Mr. Speaker, the amount.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Pero ito pong mga charges na ito, ongoing naman po eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Basically, distinguished sponsor, ang gusto ko lang naman pong maintindihan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: is are we really stopping smugglers through this fuel, through this system of fuel marking,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: or basically, ang nangyayari lang po ba is,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: are we mainly marking the fuel of legitimate importers who have already paid their taxes?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Kasi baka mamaya ang nangyayari, nag-charge lang po tayo ng additional pero hindi naman talaga naka-curb nung sistema yung pag-smuggle.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: We can identify, we determine, and we have a concrete way of determining kung sino dapat magbabayad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, Distinguished Sponsor, does the DOF have a complete and independent technical cost-benefit and supplier integrity review?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: May I ask for a copy of that?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: We already have a review evaluating other possible systems kung ano po yung posibleng mas maganda.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Kasi my understanding is that the current provider uses halogens, halogenated compounds.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And ang tanong po is na-evaluate po ba natin yan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Kasi ang balita po is hindi na po ito ginagamit sa Germany at sa China because it is carcinogenic.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: I think based on the, approved naman po ng Department of Energy and DNR po yung itong ginagamit po ng ating Bureau of Customs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, ito pong Philippine Marking System natin, na-test na po ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Has this been tested independently for safety?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And do we have, can we have, can you provide a copy of that report?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: We will, yes, we will provide for the copy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Distinguished Sponsor, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: I'll move to my next question.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, through you, what does abandoned mean for purposes of declaring savings?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Can a project be declared abandoned?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Even, even before the contract is awarded?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: If yes, on what specific grounds?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: It's, it's, Mr. Speaker, again, it's, it's entirely up, it's entirely a decision that has to be made by the Department of Budget and Management, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Because, you know, allocation of funding,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: especially fundings that are already obligated and has yet to be obligated.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: distinguished sponsor? Sorry, hindi kita marinig.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Yes po, magpaprovide po kami ng kakopya ng kriteriya o paano maka-avail.

segments.text: Gusto lang namin po i-inform din sa magalang-galang na interpolator.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Meron nakapam, nakaposta po ito sa website po ng Department of Finance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Sige po, intayin po pa rin natin at kung may mga iba pang dokumento na hindi po kita sa website kung paano po ma-access po ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang clarification ko po, Mr. Speaker, good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang sinabi po ng figures, yung P401,000,000, this was just disbursed last year?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: While cumulative po yung kanyang disbursement, Mr. Speaker, your honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, good sponsor, meron po bang datos ang DOF?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Sa magkano na po yung nag-disbursement?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Sa magkano na po yung nag-disbursed ng ahensya simula noong nagkaroon ng People's Survival Fund?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Yun na po, cumulative po yun eh. Starting from 2020.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So to correct, cumulative po ito. So since existence…

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Tingin po tayo ng kopya ng report, Mr. Speaker, good sponsor, kung magkano po yung nag-disbursed per year at anong porsyento po yung nag-disbursed kada taon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang remarkable lang po sa akin dito, Madam Speaker, good sponsor, ay it's been existent for how many years now?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Yes, that's correct po, Mrs. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ilang beses na po ba na-replenish yung People's Survival Fund?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ayon po kasi sa batas, maaari po siyang ma-replenish. So ang 1 billion, ito po yung starting amount, and meron pong provision which says that hindi po dapat bababa sa 1 billion yung nasa laman ng People's Survival Fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So ilang beses na po ba siya na-replenish, if at all, Mr. Speaker, good sponsor?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So, Mrs. Speaker, dahil ito ay cumulative, Mrs. Speaker, depende rin po dun sa disbursement kasi nga may process talaga ito mag-avail. So starting from its implementation, more than 3 times na po na-replenish itong pondo na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: More than 3 times na po na-replenish. Magkano na po siya ngayon, Mrs. Speaker, good sponsor?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: 1.5. To be exact, 1.548 million and 59,000, Mrs. Speaker, your honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So ano po rin yung sources ng replenishment na ito? Ito po ba ay galing sa budget primarily or meron po ba itong donations na nakakuha, dito po nilagay, as per law, na maaari naman pong mangyari?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So the General Appropriations Act lang po, Mrs. Speaker, ang sources ng replenishment itong pondo na ito, Mrs. Speaker, your honor. Wala pong ibang other sources.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Maaari po bang magsumiti ang ahensya kung ano po yung mga proyektong na-disbursan ng People's Survival Fund for the past years of its existence? Would that be possible po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Yes po. Magbibigay po kami ng kaukulang datos simula po itong nagumpisa, implementation nito. At kung sino po yung naka-avail nito at nabigyan itong assistance na ito, Mrs. Speaker, your honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, good sponsor, tinatanong po natin ito dahil simula noong napasa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Yung Climate Change Act noong 2009 at napasa yung amendments nito that established the People's Survival Fund noong 2012, noong marami pong tumingin dito sa adaptation fund na ito, no, essentially, no, domestic adaptation fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Para po ang iba't ibang mga LGU, kahit mga community organizations, civil society organizations, magawa nila yung iba't ibang advokasya nila sa pangklima.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: to resist climate change by applying, no, for a grant or for disbursement here. Ngunit, the knowledge that only 568 million has been disbursed in more than 15 years, for me, ay hindi natin na ma-maximize yung People's Survival Fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Sa ideal, Madam Speaker, good sponsor, kung nagagawa natin na ma-exhaust yung 1 billion sa isang taon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: basta na-insure po ng DOF, ng Climate Change Commission, ng mga iba't ibang ahensya, kahit ng DBM po, no, na lahat po ng nagagrantan nito ay naayon sa National Climate Action Plan

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: at talagang may na-me-measure na tangible effects para mapigilan yung climate change, ay that's 1 billion pesos well spent, Madam Speaker, good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, ang tanong po natin, bakit po for 15 years or more?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Well, unang-una po, Mrs. Speaker, sabi ko na sa advance po sa sinasabi namin na meron po talagang proseso ito, kung paano po ito maka-avail at the same time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Yung replenishment naman po ito is based on, yung cumulative nga po yung pag-release as what the data says, Mr. Speaker, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Ngayong tindihan po namin, in fact, sinasuportahan po natin ng DOF yung katayuan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Yung position po ng ating kagalang-galang na interpolator dahil I think we also need to do more.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Kasi this is something that, this is a funding that really goes straight to the protection of our environment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So, kami po ang Department of Finance nakikiisa po kung anuman po yung mga programa na maaaring mas mapaganda at mapabilis yung usage na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Pero again, depending on the actual number of LGS, would really avail.

segments.text: at yung utilization ng pondo na ito.

segments.text: natutuwa po tayo na marinig yun.

segments.text: doon sa mga stated purposes niya,

segments.text: pondo na ito na sana po

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Well, una-una po, again, kasi dapat

segments.text: assistance na ito. Tama po yung sinabi nyo,

segments.text: kasi kailangan po din natin make sure

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: or programs or whatever you call it,

segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Your Honor, doon po intended

segments.text: environment, but as well as yung much-needed

segments.text: program na ito na sourced out from this

segments.text: po natin yan. And if the good

segments.text: siguro huling tanong na lang po natin tungkol dito

segments.text: process itself, and the releases of

segments.text: ang nire-resolva pa nila kasama ng

segments.text: ang kinatawan na ito at the proper time and avenue.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Pero siguro, I open this up on the floor, Madam Speaker, good sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: because ito yung mga isapin kapag pinag-uusapan natin yung climate finance.

segments.text: Meron tayong commitments sa Paris Agreement, gusto natin ma-actualize sila,

segments.text: pero pagdating naman po sa paglalabas talaga ng pera para ma-actualize ito,

segments.text: ayaw natin nang mabagal sila, o kaya naman ay hindi naman mangyayari

segments.text: dahil po it will end up in paperwork hell.

segments.text: So, ang dulo naman po nito, gusto natin at the end of it ay mas madali,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: pero tama pa rin yung accountability na ma-access yung People's Survival Fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And I'd like to put on the record that I think going into 2027,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: dapat po mas hands-on tayo sa pag-disperse nito or even paggamit nito bilang mekanismo,

segments.text: So, ang maaari po natin gawin, this representation adopts the recommendation of Action Klima

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: In fact, ang position po ng DOF ay nais po nilang makakuha itong recommendation na ito

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: nang sa ganun ay maging basihan din po ito sa ongoing improvement po sa Social People's Protection Fund na ito po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So, nagpapasalamat po kami and then the DOF is willing to work with Congresswoman Renee Co

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong

segments.text: pero proteksyon po sa kanilang mga constituents, Mrs. Speaker, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Salamat po, Madam Speaker, good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang sunod po nating tanong ay tungkol naman po sa Bureau of Customs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ito po ay tungkol naman din sa usapin ng electronic waste na nakita natin na tinambak sa Subic

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: containers of that, na nahirapan yung Bureau of Customs to exercise its mandate, legal mandate, para po tuloy-tuloy na ma-check yung anuman po yung nandito sa mga containers na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Noted po natin na nagkaroon po ng joint inspection on the nine recycling site, nine recycling locators in Subic, July 1 this year, kasama ng SBMA at DNRM EMD. Ano pong findings ng joint inspection na ito, Mr. Speaker, Good Sponsor?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Kung maaari lang po lamang, magre-refer lang po ako sa data.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Pero alam ko, just while they're looking at the data, sa Bureau of Customs po, ito pong nami-mention po na mga, okay, ito pong mga e-waste na mga cargo po, for a certain period of time, kasi what is important po, Mr. Speaker, is hindi po nila dito tinatangbak.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Pinapabalik po nila ito sa country of origin, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So kung meron man lang pong time na nandoon sa isang lugar, dyan po sa na-mention na lugar po ng ating kagalang-galang na kinatawan, ng kabataan party, this is only good for a certain number of days because it really requires that they need to be processed first and then makuha po yung number so that kailangan po yung documentation before the Bureau of Customs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: And it sends them back to the country of origin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Maaari na lang po bang humingi ng kopya ng report tungkol po sa findings of this joint inspection?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Pero we raise this line of questioning, Madam Speaker, good sponsor, dahil po ang pagtambak ng e-waste, or rather, ang illegal importation of e-waste papuntang subik galing United States ay hindi po sang-ayon sa Basel Convention.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: At under the Basel Convention na ating niratipika ay ang essentially agency na in charge sa pag-ensure na ito ay nasusunod other than the DEN or andyan ang Bureau of Customs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So it's good to hear na itong July 1 and subsequent inspections ay napapabalik na po sa country of origin yung mga tunetuneladang mga e-waste na pumupunta.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Dito sa ating bansa, ayaw po natin na maging tambakan ng basura ang Pilipinas, gaya po ng ginagawa ng ibang mayamang bansa sa Southeast Asia.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, I'd like a commitment, Madam Speaker, good sponsor, on the floor, tuloy-tuloy na ba ang cooperation to ensure that illegal imports of electronic waste and toxic waste on the area is strictly prohibited under our law?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Yes, Mrs. Speaker, we can guarantee that we will call the support.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Yes, Mrs. Speaker, just to add on to the previous response that I gave to the good lady from Kabataan Party List, it's not only about Customs' role and duty to send back these e-waste cargos,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: but even the DNR also requires them to have a clear position on this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: I think this is an ongoing discussion between the Bureau of Customs and the Department of Natural Resources and Environment and Natural Resources.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So on the part of the Customs, kaya nga po nagko-cause ito ng possible alarm sa environment as well as health environment, they send them back. But as to the position of the good lady, whether the Bureau of Customs stands on whatever treaties, agreements, international covenants that we have entered into,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: definitely, we will keep solidly comply with whatever the directives from all these treaties and covenants.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: I think the Philippine government has said, entered into, Mrs. Speaker, your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Okay, maraming salamat, Madam Speaker, good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Siguro ang huling na lang nating line of questioning din tungkol dito ay meron ding nakumpirma na containers na intercepted ng Bureau of Customs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Meron po noong July 25, and according to Inquirer, it contains scrap copper from the U.S. arrived aboard MV Tokyo Express.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And meron din po isa pa na kinumpirma.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ng August 22 na suspected electronic waste.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And as far as we know, Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: wala pang inilalabas na report para sa ikalawang shipment na pinatigil.

segments.text: Maari po bang malaman ano yung findings

segments.text: ng other interceptions na ginawa ng Bureau of Customs?

segments.text: electronic waste po ba ang laman ng shipments na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Mrs. Speaker, apologies for that. Uh, Mr. Speaker, these are scrap metals upon assessment by the Bureau of Customs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: Pero when they are being tested, I think electronically,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So I think these are the scrap metals used in hospitals,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: maybe those devices that used radioactive.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: That's why they're still continuing to...

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: They're still continuing on assessing these.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: So magbibigay na lang po daw ang Bureau of Customs ng report,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: assessment report, patungkol po dito sa sinasa...

segments.speaker: Rep. Ziaur-Rahman "Zia" Alonto Adiong
segments.text: minimension po ng ating kagalang-galang na interpreter,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Hintayin din po natin yung ulat na ito,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: ay pwedeng kapag na-develop po ng guidelines patungkol dito,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: kailangan pong kunin yung approval ng Kongreso.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, again, the DBM is open to any refinements to the special provision for us to, I guess, have more clear say on the part of Congress

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: kung ano po yung mga panuntunan na kailangan sundan para po sa growth equity fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Madam Speaker, malinaw po, meron namang malinaw na pagbatayan para hindi maging lump sum ang growth equity fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya dapat itemized yan, dapat meron nang guidelines bago pa man maipasa itong GAA. Meron na dapat ngayong malinaw na pamantayan kung paano ito gagamitin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At higit sa lahat po, kinakailangan natin mapanagot kung merong may abuso sa paggamit nito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dahil kung hindi po natin yan gagawin, mananatilin pong isang malinaw na pork fund, ang growth equity fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kung walang malinaw na pamantayan kung paano ito tiyak na mapupunta sa servisyo na kailangan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Madam Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Manghihingi na lang po tayo ng ulat tungkol dun sa responsibility and accountability guidelines ng growth equity fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Madam Speaker, we will comply po. We will share the same to the Honorable Elago.

segments.speaker: Rep. Beverley Rose A. Dimacuha
segments.text: Madam Speaker, next to interpellate the sponsor, I move to recognize Representative Attorney Renee Louise Co of Kabataan Partylist.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: Representative Renee Louise Co of Kabataan Partylist is hereby recognized for her interpellation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Magandang gabi po, Madam Speaker. Maraming salamat po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And magandang gabi rin po to the Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Tatanong din po tayo ang mga natanong na rin po natin sa ibang mga ahensya but we still felt it appropriate to ask for the lump sum funds dahil po classified under LGSF

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ang support to the Barangay Development Program of the NTF-ELCAC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Sa pagbaybay lang po ng kasaysayan ng Barangay Development Program of the NTF-ELCAC, nagsimula po ito ng GAA 2021 at nagpapatuloy nitong 2027 at tinignan po natin yung mga allotments na kada taon nag-iiba.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Pansin po natin na yung budget it also varies pero nag-vary din yung numbers ng mga barangay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang recipient nito from 822 ng 2021 to ngayong GAA 2027, 1,948.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Wala pong isang taon na pare-pareho yung number ng mga barangays na purportedly cleared and therefore ay maaaring makakuha ng support sa BDP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: At iba-iba rin po yung allotments. 2021, 20 million each for the 822 barangays.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: nasasagot sa amin yung tanong na what constitutes cleared barangays under the Barangay Development Program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Meron po sa ating binigay na essentially paraan paano ikaklassify at gagawin po ng DILG at ico-collate ng DBM yung ganitong listahan in a year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: But we'd like to pursue that line of question, Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Natatrack po ba ng DBM sa budget books kung aling mga barangay ang naging beneficiary ng BDP sa mga nagdaang taon?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Natatrack po ba niya, Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor, if one barangay has been cleared for all years, may ilang barangay ba na hindi maki-clear in a particular year, mawawala sa listahan, may bago, etc.?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor, ano po bang tracking na ginawa ng DBM dito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Distinguished Colleague, yung determination po patungkol sa ano yung cleared barangay, nagmumula po yan sa NTF-ELCAC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Ang binibigay lang po sa DBM ay yung listahan na po ng mga cleared barangays.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Yung patungkol po dun sa beneficiary barangays, every year po, as you mentioned, for example, 2021, 822 barangays.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: 406 barangays, and so on and so forth po, until 2026.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Isang beses lang po, pwedeng makatanggap.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: ng SBDP, yung LGSF SBDP, yung particular cleared barangay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So they can only receive once po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Even though they're declared earlier as a cleared barangay or later,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: nakadepende po sa kailan po isusumite ng NTF-ELCAC sa DBM

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: para po as a qualified barangay po for LGSF SBDP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor, is the sponsor confirming that this is a one-time grant?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Meaning kung nabigay na po ito ng isang taon, ay hindi na po ito mabibigay sa mga succeeding years?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Yes po, Madam Speaker, distinguished colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: DBM confirms po that this is a one-time grant.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Once you've received it, you can no longer receive it in succeeding years.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor, hindi po ba unfair sa barangay?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Yung barangays who've declared themselves cleared earlier, 20 million each ang nakuha.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Lalo for example, in 2021, kumpara po sa mga ibang taon, for example, 2024, 2025,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: 2.5 million pesos lang kada barangay yung nakuha.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Distinguished Colleague, yes, we agree with the point.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: The DBM agrees with the point of our Distinguished Colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Yung determination po kasi as to how much,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: how much each barangay would receive in a particular year

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: is dependent on the allocation that LGSF SBDP receives for a particular year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Because for a particular year, the number of beneficiary barangays is predetermined by NTF-ELCAC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, halimbawa po, nagkataon na ang liit ng alokasyon ng SBDP sa taon na yun,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: yun po, I agree po, nagkakataon po na,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: May pagkakataon din naman po na konti lang sila na cleared barangays na nag-qualify,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: tas malaki yung alokasyon, so mas malaki po yung natatanggap nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, the DBM recognizes po the point of our Distinguished Colleague na

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: because of the formula and the determination,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: nagkakataon nga po talaga that some years are higher than others.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: masasabi po ba ng DBM with definitiveness na wala pong isang barangay na duplicate

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: na nakakuha ng multiple times para po sa barangay development program?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: kami po ni Sec Kim dito sa likod, tinatanong po namin yung team,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: are you absolutely sure that there's no barangay that received the SBDP twice?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: And they confirm po, as far as they know po, there's no barangay po that has received it twice.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: There's also data in Compass po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: in the DBM website that we can use to verify that information.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Does DBM check that po yearly na kung anumang listahang binibigay ng DILG

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: or ang iba't ibang ahensya ay hindi po nakakuha na noon pa?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: sorry, we're just probing also, making sure that the answer is correct.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: the DBM relies greatly on the list,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: the recommended barangays that is included in the list submitted by the NTF-ELCAC,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: but the DBM agrees that they should do a second check,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: just to make sure that there are no duplicate barangays po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang separate check na po ba ito, gagawin po ba ngayon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: or pwede po bang magsumite na lang po ang report ng DBM?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Yes, Madam Speaker, so they rely on the attestation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: so there's a certification that NTF-ELCAC,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: specifically issues to certify that there are no duplicate barangays,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: but the DBM commits po that from here on out, moving forward,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: they will do a second check po for duplicates.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, good sponsor, ito rin po yung line of questioning natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: I think, noong nagtanong tayo sa general principles,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: kahit po yung challenge natin sa DBM for confidential and intelligence funds,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: paano po ba ine-exercise ng DBM?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Yung mandato nila na hindi lang sana collator ng mga budget requests

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: pero ano po bang paraan na ginagawa nila to ensure na

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: yung mga binubukas ng mga ibat-ibang ahensya at that level pa lang

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: before po isubmit yung request for the budget at maaprubahan

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, two years down the line, kung mayroon pong pagkakamali,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: may opportunity ang DBM kung paano po siya,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: hindi lang i-double check, pero tignan kung mayroon pong kailangan i-improve or hindi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: kung mayroon pong maiprovide yung DBM na kopya ng attestation

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: para makita po natin kung ano pong mga checks yung ginagawa

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ng hindi lang ng DBM pero ng NTF-ELCAC and DILG,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: para makita kung ano yung mga proseso nila sa paglatag,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: anong mga baranggay, yung cleared or hindi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Pero dahil Madam Speaker, as I mentioned nga po earlier,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: yung isang point na po na, well, one, unfair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: How can we say na each baranggay makukuha nila yung kailangan nila

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: o yung dapat na makuha nila kung each year mukhang dependent sa allocation?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: 20 million for this year, 2.5 million the next.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: What's to say na ito talaga yung parang solusyon na kailangan nila?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And dahil, secondly, Madam Speaker, and this is our standing critique of the program,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: nasa budget naman po ng mga iba't-ibang ahensya na may specific mandate

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: to provide these services na pwedeng dun po ilagay yung pangailangan

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ng mga local government units natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Rather than through this program na standing pa rin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: yung pinupoint out natin na quote-unquote conditional development po

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ang inooffer ng barangay development program ng NTF-ELCAC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And third point, kung this conditional development comes at the cost of the suppression of rights

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: and freedoms of the people, dahil ang report sa atin on ground,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: paano ba nag-clear yung isang baranggay, tatanong-tanongin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: kung ang student leader sa isang campus ay affiliated ka daw ba sa leftist groups?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Can you sign this memo to say hindi? Etc.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Surveillance, harassment, lahat po ito ay begging the question na

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: is this the best way for development?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Or is it, you know, proper funding of the different projects

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: to the appropriate line items to the different agencies?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, good sponsor, hindi po ito ang tunay na pagpapaunlad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Hindi nito natutugunan ang sinasabi ng layunin na wakasan ng armadong tunggalian

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: na nangyayari sa bansa natin ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Sa halip na ilagay ang programang malabo ang proseso at pamantayang para magpa-clear

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: at meron nga pong maaaring mangyari na may tunggalian pa sa mga baranggay

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: dahil hindi po pantay yung nakukuha nila,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: mas mabuti pang ilagay na lang ang pondo sa direktang mga serbisyong panlipunan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, good sponsor, we look forward to receiving the report

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: on how DILG and NTF-ELCAC attests na hindi po duplicates and whatever else methods

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: to ensure na hindi naman nauulit yung mga baranggay

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: as per the rules and regulations of this program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: But for now, I have no further questions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Thank you very much to the sponsor

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: for answering our questions and I yield my time to the floor.

segments.text: Thank you very much, Madam Speaker.

segments.text: Thank you very much to the Honorable Renee Co.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Madam Speaker, distinguished colleague, so the DBM, what we state in the GAA is that the DBM will be the one to execute from the point of evaluating to the point of releasing of the LGSF based on the menu po na ating inilalagay doon po sa GAA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, in regard to how they evaluate, they have a scorecard po that they use as a basis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Tulad po ng nabanggit, ilan po sa mga tinitignan nila ay good financial housekeeping, functionality of the local development council, compliance with subay-bayan reporting requirements, financial accomplishment, physical accomplishment, and the like.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Nakabase din po sila doon po sa request ng mga LGUs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, yung iba po kasi LGU nag-request, yung iba naman po hindi din.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, limited din po sila by the types of requests na dumadating sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, all of the whole process po from the time of setting the criteria and getting the requests po through the portal of DBM, evaluating it and eventually releasing it, lahat po yan nasa loob po ng DBM.

segments.text: Kaya po namin tinawag to, last year pa, this is presidential pork.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Before I proceed, I would like

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: and our colleagues from the Majority

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: and I will show you your priorities. The proposed budget is 7.2 trillion pesos. But the 7.2 trillion pesos headline does not tell the whole story.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Government expects approximately 5.2 trillion in revenues in 2027. Interest payments alone will reach approximately 1.114 trillion. Principal amortization is about 1.59 trillion.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Perhaps payments are financing transactions and are, strictly speaking,

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: not part of the 7.2 trillion expenditure program, but they remain actual obligations of the Treasury.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Taken together, that service reaches approximately 2.7 trillion, equivalent to almost 52 for every 100 pesos of projected government revenue.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Then, government must provide for the national tax allotment, salaries, pensions, statutory contributions, and other mandatory expenditures.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: So while we speak of a 7.2 trillion budget, the amount over which government actually has room to make choices is much smaller.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: About 36 percent of the 7.2 trillion budget.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Kung ganoon, pagkatapos bayaran ang utang at ang mga obligasyon, hindi na maaring pagpaliban, mas maliit ang perang tunay nating mapapagpasyahan.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: That is fiscal reality behind this budget.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: This budget will also operate in a difficult economic environment.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: GDP grew by only 2.3 percent in the second quarter of 2026, after growth of 2.8 percent in the first quarter.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Industry contracted by 2.4 percent, while gross capital formation fell by 9.2%.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: At the same time, inflation remained high at 6.1 percent in August.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: For the bottom 30 percent of Filipino households, inflation was even higher at 8.2 percent.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: These numbers matter because slower growth limits income and employment opportunities.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Inflation reduces what those incomes can buy.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Para sa ordinaryong pamilya, simply lang ang ibig sabihin nito, mas mabagal na paglago ng kita, pero mas mabilis ang pagtaas ng presyo ng mga bilihin at serbisyo.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: This is why the quality of government spending matters as much as its size.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: The minority recognizes the need for fiscal consolidation. Under the government's medium-term framework, the deficit is expected to decline from approximately 5.4% of GDP in 2026 to 3.5% by 2030.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: But the revenues remain broadly around 15-16% of GDP, while disbursements decline from approximately 21.2% to 19.1%.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Much of the adjustments, therefore, comes from expenditure restraint.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: There is nothing wrong with spending discipline.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Government shall eliminate waste, duplication, and projects that cannot be implemented.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: But restraint should protect essential investments in people and productive capacity.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Education illustrates the pressure on our fiscal space.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: The proposed DepEd budget is approximately P976 billion.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: While interest payments alone are approximately P1.114 trillion.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: We therefore spend about P138 billion more on interest than on the entire Department of Education.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Education sector spending is approximately 3.99% of GDP,

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: 4.36% under the fiscal year of 2026 GAA.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: The 4Ps allocation moves from approximately P113 billion to P99.08 billion.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: ...from approximately P63.9 billion to P33.29 billion.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: And the supplementary feeding program for approximately P9.56 billion to P6.36 billion.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: There may be a valid program and targeting reasons for these adjustments.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: But with inflation among our poorest households,

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: dapat unang protektahan ang mga programang

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: come at the expense of human

segments.text: As long as the policy is privatization, deregulation, liberalization, debt-driven patronage,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: and dependence on a foreign power, the budget will reflect it, no matter how many line items we amend.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kaya ang laban ay hindi lamang laban sa loob ng General Appropriations Bill.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang laban ay para baguhin ang patakaran na pinagsisilbihan nito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: It is a fight for a budget that serves the Filipino people, not the oligarchs, not the dynasties, not a foreign power.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Budget para sa serbisyo, hindi para sa pork, para sa mamamayan, hindi para sa ilan, para sa bayan, hindi para sa dayuhan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ferdinand Alexander A. Marcos
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I move to close the period of sponsorship and debate on House Bill No. 10858.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: Is there any objection? The Chair hears none. The motion is approved.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ferdinand Alexander A. Marcos
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I move to suspend consideration of House Bill No. 10858.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: Is there any objection? The Chair hears none. The motion is approved.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ferdinand Alexander A. Marcos
segments.text: Madam Speaker, there being no business left for the day, after two grueling weeks, I move to adjourn until Tuesday, 3 p.m., the 29th of September.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: The Chair hears none. The motion is approved.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: Session is adjourned until September 29, Tuesday at 3 p.m.
